# Chart

**Figma:** ❖ Chart (7032:8969): Chart/Line-Chart 6643:63324, Chart/Stack-Bar-Chart 6643:73471, Chart/Chart-Card 6643:63528  
**Import:** `import { ChartCard, LineChart, StackBarChart } from "@zen/design-system";`

Show how a value changes over time (Line) or how parts make up a total (Stack bar), framed by a Chart Card with a title and range switch.

## Use it for
- Trends over a few periods (4–12 points) → LineChart.
- Part-to-whole across periods → StackBarChart with a legend.
- Dashboard tiles → ChartCard next to Metric Cards.

## Use something else for
- One number → Metric / MetricCard.
- Exact values to compare or export → Table.
- More than ~7 series → split the chart or use a Table.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Line | `LineChart data[] {label, value} · format · height` | Accent/Solid 2px line, Accent area, dashed Pale grid |
| Stack bar | `StackBarChart data[] {label, values} · series[] {id, label, color} · showLegend` | Figma palette: Sector Primary, Secondary, Cyan, Violet, Yellow… |
| Card | `ChartCard title · headingLevel · onOpen · ranges · range · onRangeChange` | Card Flat Medium: Heading/Subheading + chevron, Segmented; headingLevel is one below the nearest heading above: 3 by default (under a section h2), 2 when the card sits directly under the page title; the style stays Heading/Subheading |
| Interaction | `initialIndex` | ←/→ Home/End move the active point; the Tooltip shows its value |

### Types
Object shapes the props above refer to.

```ts
interface ChartPoint { label: string; value: number }
interface ChartSeries { id: string; label: string; color?: string }
interface ChartStack { label: string; values: Record<string, number> }
type SegmentedOption = { id: string; label: ReactNode; leading?: IconName | ReactNode; badge?: ReactNode; state?: SegmentedState; disabled?: boolean; "aria-label"?: string; }
type SegmentedState = "default" | "hover" | "focused" | "disabled"
```

## Keyboard
| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Focus the chart |
| ← / → | Previous / next point (the Tooltip follows) |
| Home / End | First / last point |

## ✅ Do
- Always give the chart an aria-label that says what it shows and over which range.
- Format values for people (`$23.4K`, `52 GB`) with `format`.
- Keep the legend on stack bars so colour is never the only key (harness: chart/stack-needs-legend).
- Use the Segmented range switch in the card instead of separate charts per range.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't use a line for categories that aren't ordered in time.
- Don't pick custom colours outside the chart palette unless a series has a fixed brand colour.
- Don't put a chart where the user needs exact values; add a Table.

## Accessibility
- The plot is a focusable group (aria-roledescription="chart") named by aria-label; ←/→, Home/End move between points and a live summary reads "Q2: $14.8K (2 of 4)".
- Stack-bar legends label every colour; the summary lists each series' value for the active column.

## Content
- Title names the measure ("Expense Trends", "Budget Allocation"); axis labels are short (Q1, Jan, W1).
- Before there is data, keep the card title and put an EmptyState in the card: it takes the next heading level in Body/Extra/Bold, so it never outranks or outsizes the card title.

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chart/stack-needs-legend` | error | Stack-bar charts keep their legend so colour is never the only key. | `zen-allow-chart-legend: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
| `interaction/controlled-needs-handler` | warn | A controlled prop comes with its change handler (month + onMonthChange, value + onValueChange, open + onOpenChange, pageSize + onPageSizeChange…): without it nothing can change the value and the control is frozen, e.g. a DatePicker whose Previous/Next do nothing. Bare booleans (a fixed preview) and `x ? true : undefined` pins pass. | `zen-allow-controlled-handler: <reason>` |
